## Why This Is Asked

- Lambda versions and alias-based traffic shifting

```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation skeletons (AppConfig and Lambda alias)
Resources:
  AppConfigApplication:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::Application
    Properties:
      Name: MyApiApp
  AppConfigEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::AppConfig::Environment
    Properties:
      Name: Prod
      ApplicationId: !Ref AppConfigApplication

    Type: AWS::AppConfig::ConfigurationProfile
    Properties:
      Name: FeatureFlags
      ApplicationId: !Ref AppConfigApplication
```

```yaml
# CloudFormation: Cross-account role trust
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  ProdCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_A_ID:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ProdAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeClusters
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                  - codepipeline:*
                Resource: '*'
```

```yaml
# CloudFormation: Minimal CodePipeline scaffold
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
```

```yaml
# SAM template snippet
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: app.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.8
      CodeUri: .
      AutoPublishAlias: live
      DeploymentPreference:
        Type: Linear
        Alarms:
          - !Ref MyAlarm
```

```yaml
# Buildspec example
version: 0.2
phases:

    runtime-versions:

    commands:
      - pytest -q

artifacts:
  files:
    - '**/*'
```
